question: Which layer of the hair shaft contains the pigment granules (melanin) that determine hair color?
options: A. Medulla
B. Cuticle
C. Cortex
D. Papilla

question: When performing a virgin relaxer application, the relaxer cream should be applied in which sequence?
options: A. From the nape, working toward the front hairline, then the crown
B. Starting at the crown and working outward to the perimeter
C. Beginning at the front hairline and moving toward the nape
D. Randomly throughout the head to ensure even coverage

question: A client presents with tinea capitis. As a cosmetologist, what is the most appropriate course of action?
options: A. Apply an antifungal shampoo and proceed with the service
B. Refer the client to a medical professional and decline the service
C. Cleanse the scalp thoroughly and continue with a mild chemical service
D. Apply a protein treatment to strengthen the affected area

question: In color theory, which level system number represents the darkest possible hair color?
options: A. Level 10
B. Level 5
C. Level 1
D. Level 3

question: What is the primary chemical action of an alkaline permanent wave solution on the hair?
options: A. It oxidizes the disulfide bonds in the cortex
B. It softens and swells the hair, breaking disulfide bonds
C. It deposits color molecules into the cuticle layer
D. It hardens the cuticle to accept the waving lotion

question: Which type of melanin is responsible for red and yellow pigment tones in hair?
options: A. Eumelanin
B. Neuromelanin
C. Pheomelanin
D. Trichosiderin

question: When formulating a tint to cover 75% resistant gray hair, which of the following approaches is most appropriate?
options: A. Use the target level shade with 10 volume developer
B. Mix equal parts of target level and one level lighter with 20 volume developer
C. Mix equal parts of target level and one level darker with 20 volume developer
D. Use a high-lift color with 40 volume developer

question: What does the term 'elasticity' refer to when analyzing hair prior to a chemical service?
options: A. The hair's ability to absorb and hold moisture
B. The hair's ability to stretch and return to its original length
C. The porosity of the cuticle layer
D. The diameter of the individual hair strand

question: During a scalp massage, which technique involves a firm, circular movement using the fingertips without lifting them from the scalp?
options: A. Effleurage
B. Tapotement
C. Petrissage
D. Friction

question: Which of the following best describes the function of a normalizing or acid-balanced conditioner applied after a relaxer service?
options: A. It re-oxidizes the hair and closes the cuticle while returning the hair to its natural pH
B. It continues the relaxing process to ensure complete straightening
C. It deposits protein bonds permanently into the cortex
D. It strips residual relaxer from the scalp only

question: In nail technology, onychomycosis refers to which condition?
options: A. Bacterial infection of the nail fold
B. Fungal infection of the nail plate
C. Separation of the nail plate from the nail bed
D. Bruising beneath the nail plate

question: When performing a corrective color service to remove excess artificial pigment (color correction), which technique is typically employed first?
options: A. Applying a high-lift tint with 40 volume developer
B. Using a color remover or reducing agent to strip artificial pigment
C. Bleaching the hair directly to the target level
D. Applying a filler to equalize porosity before depositing new color

question: Which angle of elevation is used when cutting a one-length bob to ensure no layering occurs?
options: A. 45-degree elevation
B. 90-degree elevation
C. 0-degree elevation
D. 180-degree elevation

question: What is the primary difference between a semi-permanent hair color and a demi-permanent hair color?
options: A. Semi-permanent uses low-volume developer while demi-permanent requires no developer
B. Demi-permanent uses a low-volume developer and can slightly lighten, while semi-permanent requires no developer and only deposits color
C. Semi-permanent penetrates the cortex while demi-permanent only coats the cuticle
D. Demi-permanent is ammonia-based while semi-permanent is peroxide-based

question: Under the Caribbean Vocational Qualification (CVQ) framework, which competency standard requires a cosmetologist to demonstrate safe handling, storage, and disposal of hazardous chemicals in the salon environment?
options: A. Provide hair-colouring services
B. Maintain health, safety and security in the salon
C. Provide consultation services to clients
D. Monitor and maintain salon reception
